review_notes: I read the whole file. The new declarations are CurvePoint, orderAt, zeroPointEmbedding, divisor and the supporting lemmas. I searched Mathlib's AlgebraicGeometry directory for order-of-vanishing, divisor, curve-point and orderAt declarations and found no match. CurvePoint is a plain subtype of the non-generic points, so it is an abbreviation and not a competing structure. orderAt uses Mathlib's IsDiscreteValuationRing.addVal. divisor uses Finsupp.ofSupportFinite and Mathlib's IdealSheafData.support. I did not find an independent Mathlib concept that duplicates these. Within the project, the names CurvePoint and orderAt appear to be defined only in this file. Other files that mention them (for example CurvePlaceSectionDivisor.lean) were only grepped, not read, so a competing project-level version there is not ruled out. My uncertainty is that Mathlib may have a Cartier or Weil divisor API elsewhere that I did not find.
